plan.text: After this trick, win with DK unless East’s play requires DA; preserve the other honor. Cash CA and CK, then lead C8 to dummy’s CQ. If clubs split 3–2, a low heart from dummy toward HA can return the lead to South, allowing a fourth club to run. Reassess the remaining heart and diamond honors, and look for a safe entry back to dummy to use HK; if clubs are 4–1, seek the extra trick elsewhere.

advice.publicReason: Play low under West’s DQ. South has DA and DK to take the trick; D3 preserves the higher dummy diamonds for possible later use and lets South choose the appropriate honor after East plays.
